The '''Cormond Museum of Arts''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] in [[Cormond]], [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. On 14:3:1 [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it hosted the "[[Cradle of the Galaxy]]" exhibit.
